== Dialogue ==
Before completing the Missing Daughter quest:
:''"I cannot believe this is happening. I was working just around the corner while my daughter was playing here in the street. I came outside to check on her, and saw that she was gone! I cannot find her anywhere!"''

After completing the Missing Daughter quest:
:''"Thank you again for rescuing my daughter. I do not know what I would have done without your help."''
